fusions.name: Tension Bead
fusions.desc: Looses a bead of water at an enemy up to 8 tiles away. It deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Loosed Downpour
fusions.desc: After a 1-second draw, looses 3 arrows of water, spread apart. Each one falls on the first enemy it meets and deals 20 damage, then bursts and hits every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Artesian
fusions.desc: You restore 10 health, and for 12 seconds your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Meniscus
fusions.desc: The moment your mana is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
